text: On it — a subagent is investigating the value-vs-pointer receiver problem in errors.go (Error's Is/As/Unwrap only work for the pointer form). ETA ~10 min.
On it — a subagent is looking at response_writer.go so a WriteHeader after the response is committed no longer overwrites the reported status. ETA ~10 min.
On it — a subagent is investigating the route-tree path for routes registered after the first request (params coming back empty). ETA ~15 min.
Started on it: a subagent is fixing the `invalid node type` panic in the case-insensitive path lookup (tree.go) so /PREFIX/XXX redirects to /prefix/xxx and /prefix/a/b/c 404s. ETA ~12 min.
Started on it: a subagent is fixing the index-out-of-range panic in Context.NegotiateFormat so a longer Accept value like "image/tiff-fx" simply doesn't match and returns "". ETA ~12 min.
Started on it: a subagent is fixing FileAttachment so the filename in Content-Disposition is escaped (quotes/backslashes) instead of being written raw. ETA ~12 min.

Fixed. Cause: `Error` implements `error` with a value receiver but `Unwrap` was declared on `*Error`, so a wrapped `Error{...}` value had no `Unwrap` in its method set and errors.Is/As stopped there. Changed `func (msg *Error) Unwrap()` to `func (msg Error) Unwrap()` in errors.go. Both `errors.Is(wrapped, innerErr)` and `errors.As(wrapped, &target)` now return true for the value form (pointer form unchanged); full test suite green.

Fixed. Cause: `responseWriter.WriteHeader` only logged the "headers were already written" warning and then still overwrote `w.status`. Added a `return` in that branch (response_writer.go), so once the response is committed a later WriteHeader no longer changes `Status()`; the warning is still printed, pre-commit overrides still work, and the client still gets 200. Full test suite green.

Fixed. Cause: `Engine.allocateContext` sizes the pooled Context's params/skippedNodes slices from `engine.maxParams`/`maxSections` at pool-creation time, and a later `addRoute` raises those counters without growing the pooled slices — so params were silently dropped (cap guard) or the catch-all branch panicked. `Context.reset()` now re-allocates `*c.params` and `*c.skippedNodes` when their capacity is below the engine's current maxima. Registering `/test/:name/:last_name/*wild` after the first (404) request now yields 200 with name=john, last_name=smith, wild=/is/super/great, exactly as if registered up front. Full test suite green.
A subagent is fixing the `invalid node type` panic in the case-insensitive path lookup (tree.go findCaseInsensitivePathRec) — it's still running; ETA ~6 min.

Fixed. Cause: the byte-compare loop in `Context.NegotiateFormat` was bounded only by the accepted value's length, so `offer[i]` indexed past the end when the Accept value was longer and shared the offer as a prefix. Now `for ; i < len(accepted) && i < len(offer); i++`, so `NegotiateFormat("image/tiff")` with Accept `image/tiff-fx` returns "" (and `Negotiate` returns 406) instead of panicking. Wildcard/exact matching unchanged, full test suite green.

Fixed. Cause: `FileAttachment` concatenated the filename into `Content-Disposition` raw, so quotes/backslashes could inject extra parameters. Added an `escapeQuotes` helper (utils.go, same semantics as mime/multipart) and used it in the ASCII branch of FileAttachment. `evil"; dummy="x.sh` now stays a single well-formed filename parameter; the UTF-8 `filename*=UTF-8''` branch is untouched and the full test suite is green.
